data.name: Pretty Pink Duffy - Seaforth Boat Rental
data.headline: 2 hour options, Book Online or Call the Boat Rental Office at 619-223-1681
data.description: Be your own captain. Experience the sights and sounds of Mission Bay Park free of rattling engine noise while touring the famous beachside waterfront playground.
data.what_is_included:
Max of 10 passengers including children (not to exceed 1500 lbs.)
Must be 18+ to rent and drive
Quiet Electic Engine
Spacious, upholstered bench seating arrangement
Full bimini top
Bluetooth stereo system
Life vests included (all sizes)

data.cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
data.disclaimers: - NO Drugs, Hard Liquor, Red Wine, or Glass Containers allowed. Please drink responsibly and be over 21 years old. Rentals with overly intoxicated party members will be cancelled. Drivers must refrain from any alcohol consumption
